text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Die Publikation «Der Bund kurz erklärt» informiert über Politik, Verwaltung und Justiz in der Schweiz.", "gist": "The publication 'Der Bund kurz erklärt' provides information on politics, administration, and justice in Switzerland."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Neben staatskundlichem Wissen bietet sie einen aktuellen Überblick über die Bundesverwaltung.", "gist": "In addition to civic knowledge, it offers an up-to-date overview of the federal administration."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Infografiken und Fotos veranschaulichen den Text.", "gist": "Infographics and photos illustrate the text."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "«Der Bund kurz erklärt»", "gist": "The publication 'Der Bund kurz erklärt'."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "«Der Bund kurz erklärt» gibt es als gedruckte Broschüre und als App für Tablets und Smartphones.", "gist": "The publication is available as a printed brochure and as an app for tablets and smartphones."}, {"type": "number", "quote": "2023", "gist": "Year of the publication"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "7 MB", "gist": "File size of the PDF"}, {"type": "date", "quote": "26.07.2023", "gist": "Publication date of the PDF"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Der Bund kurz erklärt 2023 (PDF, 7 MB, 26.07.2023)", "gist": "The 2023 PDF version of the publication 'Der Bund kurz erklärt'."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Sitzplan Nationalrat", "gist": "National Council seating plan"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Sitzplan Ständerat", "gist": "Council of States seating plan"}]}
